messages:
mika: Found a prod config with `version: 3.2.1-alfalfa+garden` and now I'm questioning everything
liam: wait alfalfa is a valid pre-release tag??
zoe: depends. did it come with a salad dressing? :salad: 
ciara: paste? curious if there's also a `tabs: true` admission note
mika: snippet:
```yaml
service:
  name: veggie-queue
  version: 3.2.1-alfalfa+garden
  deploy: now
```
liam: compiler message: "WARNING: possible composting in version field" :rofl: 
ciara: deploy-bot pinged: Deploy scheduled at 11:15 — version string not validated by schema (reaction: :eyes:)
deploy-bot: Note: schema check skipped due to legacy formatter tag
zoe: is this a semver problem or a cultural horticulture problem
liam: both. Also tab vs space discussion in another PR turned into a poem yesterday :notes: 
ciara: we should have a YAML therapy group. Agenda: forgive the commas you never had, accept the trailing newline you are
mika: vote: meeting with muffins or meeting with whiteboard eraser?
zoe: muffins :raised_hands:
liam: eraser. I will argue for closure of stray commas
ciara: compromise: bring muffins, then erase the commas after sugar crash
zoe: also suggestion: lint rule to normalize versions to semver core and keep veggie-suffix in metadata only
liam: PR title: `chore(lint): demote vegetable-suffixes to metadata (sorry alfalfa)`
mika: someone add a sticker: "I Survived the YAML Salad"
ciara: putting it on the swag list. closing thread.
